name: ddd-plugin-dev
description: Development tooling and tests for the AI-DLC v2 DDD plugin.

scripts.build:all: bun run build:claude && bun run build:codex
scripts.check: bun run check:biome && bun run validate && bun run test:development-scopes && bun run prepare:state-exposure && bun run prepare:error-contract && bun run test && bun run test:state-exposure:native && bun run experiment:rust-syn && bun run verify:state-exposure && bun run verify:error-contract && bun run typecheck:state-exposure && bun run typecheck:error-contract
scripts.test:sandbox: bun run test:coverage && bun run build:all && for h in claude codex; do bun ../.codex/tools/aidlc-plugin-test.ts . --install .. --harness $h || exit 1; done && bun scripts/verify-dist.ts && bun test tests/t1-gate-integration.test.ts && bun run test:install
scripts.test:coverage: bun test tests/t8-declaration-language.test.ts tests/t9-sensor-contract.test.ts tests/t10-rust-module-layout.test.ts && bun scripts/report-sensor-coverage.ts
scripts.test:install:remote: DDD_VERIFY_REMOTE_INSTALL=1 bun test tests/install-sandbox.test.ts -t 'real GitHub main'
